links.outcome: GPT-4 diagnostic accuracy on retinal OCT images versus retinal specialists
links.effect: GPT-4 diagnostic accuracy was consistently around 26% across four experiments, versus 93.75% for retinal disease specialists.
links.quote: In four distinct experiments, the diagnostic accuracy of GPT-4 was consistently around 26%, which showed a significant disparity compared to the diagnostic accuracy of retinal disease specialists (93.75%).

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of GPT-4 on OCT images from 80 patients compared to expert ophthalmologists, without testing a specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
